sentences.l2: 寒い地方でもよく育つ米を作るために、ある研究者は十年以上かけて品種の改良を続けてきた。
sentences.l1: In order to produce rice that grows well even in cold regions, a certain researcher has continued improving varieties for more than ten years.

sentences.l2: いくつもの品種を掛け合わせ、寒さに強く、味もよいものを選んでいく作業は、とても時間がかかる。
sentences.l1: The work of crossbreeding many varieties and selecting ones that are strong against cold and also taste good takes a lot of time.

sentences.l2: 何度も失敗したが、研究者は諦めずに記録を分析し、育てる環境を少しずつ変えていった。
sentences.l1: He failed many times, but the researcher did not give up, analyzed the records, and changed the growing environment little by little.

sentences.l2: そしてついに、新しい品種の開発に成功した。
sentences.l1: And finally, he succeeded in developing a new variety.

sentences.l2: 今では、その米が寒い地方の農家の大事な収入を支えている。
sentences.l1: Now, that rice supports the important income of farmers in cold regions.
